reason: The original note incorrectly attributed E274A/N378C site-mutant quantum-yield data to the 2012 JACS photolyase article. The opened PMC full text identifies its experimental constraints as T/U substrate variants, visible-to-UV femtosecond transient absorption, structural distances and Marcus analysis; searches within the article for 'mutant' and 'E274A' returned no matching text. The mutation statement was unsupported for this paper and has been removed.

changes.before: E274A（靠近底物侧）和 N378C（靠近辅基侧）突变使总修复量子产率分别降至约 0.40 和 0.69，说明活性位点电性与几何共同影响催化分流。注意：突变编号 E274/N378 对应 *E. coli* 构建体；文中用于展示复合物的 *A. nidulans* 结构编号为 E283/N386，不能混用。
changes.after: 本篇没有提供 E274A/N378C 等位点突变的验证；通道证据来自 T/U 底物位置异构体的动力学差异、结构距离与 Marcus 分析。
